newsitem.title: THAILAND: GF, SITCA file merger plans.
newsitem.headline: GF, SITCA file merger plans.

text.p: General Finance and Securities Plc (GF) and SITCA Investment and Securities Plc filed separate proposals to merge with other firms, a finance ministry official said on Monday.
The official said GF sought to merge with a number of finance companies including G.C.N. Finance Plc. He declined to name its other partners.
SITCA president Weera Manakongtreecheep said last week his firm and six corporate allies would seek to form a new company for undertaking universal banking.
He said the timing of the merger of his group would depend on the central bank policy on the scope of business that it could undertake.

The government said last week it would provide financial assistance and tax incentives for mergers among Thailand's 91 finance and securities firms which have been hurt by growing non-performing loans to the property sector.
